text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning countless races 
together with Narita Taishin—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...It's a hot spring, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ticket and Hayahide said they're busy too, 
and I don't have anyone else to ask.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: So... if you're saying you're free...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The hot springs trip voucher won from the 
shopping district raffle. The day has 
finally come to use it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For that sake... I have to clear away all 
the paperwork that's piled up behind the 
scenes of the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With determination harbored in my heart, I 
spent the next few days completely 
immersed in work.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I've received everything without fail! 
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Um... you look quite exhausted, so please 
make sure to get some rest, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day after finishing all the work—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. The schedule looks fine, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Can you really go on a trip when you're 
staggering around like that?
choice_data_list:
A good soak in the hot spring will wash 
all that fatigue away!

A good soak in the hot spring will wash 
all that fatigue away!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And with that—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Whoa...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Would a shopping district really offer 
something this extravagant as a raffle 
prize...?
choice_data_list: Looking forward to the hot springs!
Looking forward to the hot springs!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Well, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the bath— Soaking in the hot springs 
seems to have washed away the fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My head feels a little fuzzy, but I'm sure 
it'll clear up soon.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah, are you done for the day too?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well... it wasn't bad, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Wait, isn't your face kind of red? Did the 
hot water get to you or something?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah, h-hey...?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hey, are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hey... Trainer...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...You're finally awake. Do you remember 
collapsing from overheating?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Do you even understand what you're 
apologizing for?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sorry for ruining our trip," or "I'm 
sorry for collapsing and causing trouble"—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
If that's what you're thinking, I'm 
seriously gonna kick you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...I just checked with Tazuna-san. Is it 
true you pushed yourself to the brink at 
work just to make this trip?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Collapsing after all that helps no one, 
dummy.
choice_data_list:
I thought it could be a reward for winning 
the race...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Seriously, you. Just how stupid can you 
get?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, she suddenly reached out 
toward me—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (GRRRRRRRR!!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
The waiter taught me a pressure point that 
helps with dizziness from the bath.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hey, stay still...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The pain was so sharp that I reflexively 
recoiled and pulled away from Narita 
Taishin's grip, but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't run away.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Looking at me with puppy-dog eyes won't 
work. I'm not showing any mercy.
choice_data_list: C-Come on, please work with me here...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: No! Questions! Asked!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"If you've learned your lesson from this, 
don't go overdoing it for my sake again."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You're the only weirdo out there willing 
to be my Trainer anyway, so—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It would really be a problem if you left 
me now of all times.
choice_data_list:
With how you are now, Taishin, you'll be 
in high demand.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Nggghhh!! That's not what I'm talking 
about...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: "...Just understand. It has to be you."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ......Get a clue already.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Narita Taishin...
